integrity: Scientific proof and exact reproducible finite checks are supplied in the same package; the checks do not replace proofs of universal assertions.
scientific_limitations: The arbitrary-relation fiber law is proved only over finite labelled total orders, with all four modalities of Balbiani–Gencer and all persistent valuations. Class and maximal-fiber values have been exhaustively established only for carrier sizes at most four. No global historical-priority certification is claimed.
title: Four-modal observational fibers on finite intuitionistic chains
